subject: ClearWave demo plan — hold while they reprioritize analytics work
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.j@clearwave.io>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@clearwave.io>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for ClearWave — proposed times

Hi Clara / Sanjay,

Great talking briefly last week — thanks for the interest. I put together a short one-pager attached that outlines what we usually cover in a 45-minute technical demo: runtime performance, cost levers (batching, caching), and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC).

Are any of these slots good for you next week?
- Wed 19 May, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu 20 May, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 21 May, 10:00–10:45 PT

If you want Kiran (infra) or your security lead on the call, tell me and I’ll include an SOC2 excerpt.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you pick a time.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183
Attachment: redwood_one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Clara Jensen <clara.j@clearwave.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for ClearWave — proposed times

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the notes. Wed 19 May at 11:00 PT works best for us. Please include Kiran (infra) and I’ll try to get Sanjay (head of product) on the call as well.

Also: could you attach the SOC2 excerpt you mentioned? Our procurement/security team will want to scan that ahead of time.

—Clara

Director of Product Operations | ClearWave
cc: Kiran Patel <kiran.p@clearwave.io>
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for ClearWave — proposed times

Perfect — thanks. I’ve booked Wed 19 May, 11:00–11:45 PT and attached the calendar invite and SOC2 excerpt. Agenda: 5m intros, 30m demo (latency/cost/ops), 10m Q&A + next steps.

Marissa (CS lead) is looped for any follow-up during onboarding if the pilot moves forward.

See you then — invite attached.

Best,
Logan
Attachment: clearwave-demo-invite.ics (text/calendar); SOC2-excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Clara Jensen <clara.j@clearwave.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for ClearWave — proposed times

Logan —

Quick update from our side: we’ve had a product leadership sync this morning and they’re shifting several initiatives into the analytics platform for the next two quarters. Given that change, the LLM/inference pilot is being deprioritized for now.

We need to pause the demo scheduled for Wed 19 May. I’m sorry for the short notice — we should be able to re-evaluate in Q4, but I can’t commit to dates today. I’ll reach back out when the timing is right.

Appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Clara
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearWave demo — prospect deprioritized (next steps)

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Clara’s note below. ClearWave just deprioritized the LLM pilot in favor of analytics work and asked to pause the demo. The calendar invite and SOC2 were already sent.

Proposed next steps:
- Offer a short 15–minute checkpoint to stay top-of-mind (no demo), invite only if they want it
- Offer to keep them on our pilot waitlist and follow up in ~12 weeks
- Put a hold on the deal in HubSpot, mark reason = roadmap pivot, and set a follow-up task for 2027-08-20

Any other suggestions if we want to salvage momentum (credits, tailored brief, exec intro)? I’m OK with a light-touch approach — don’t want to push while they’re reorganizing.

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (original thread quoted)
